filter-due-previous-week: Bataih bak minggu nyang ka leupah
filter-due-next-month: Bataih bak buleuen nyang teuma teuka
filter-column-age-disabled: Bèk peusom meunurot treb lam dapeuta
filter-column-age-hint: Peusom kartu nyang tamong bak dapeuta nyoe leubèh nibak bilangan uroe nyoe nyang ka leupah. Dapeuta laén ngön kartu nyang hana diteupue tanggai tamong teutab deuh. Meunyo kartu diubah, treb jih lam dapeuta hana diitông phon lom.
filter-on-desc: Droeneueh teungoh saring kad bak papan nyoe. Klik keunoe keu sunting saringan.
advanced-filter-card-dates-hint: Saréng tanggai kad ngön @createdAt, @receivedAt, @startAt, @dueAt, @endAt atawa @listEnteredAt. Contoh: @endAt >= '2026-01-01' atawa @endAt = none. Boh tanda kutip bak nan ruang khusuih nyang geuphôn ngön @.
advanced-filter-description: Saringan lanjot jeuet geutuleh seubagoe teks ngon operator nyoe: == != <= >= && || ( ) Spasi geungui keu peupisah antara operator. Droeneueh jeuet saring mandum ruang khusus ngon tuleh nan ngon nilai jih. Contoh: Field1 == Value1. Catatan: Meunyoe ruang atawa nilai na spasi, droeneueh haroh boh tanda petik tunggai di keue ngon di likot jih. Contoh: 'Field 1' == 'Value 1'. Keu escape karakter kontrol tunggai (' \/) nyan, droeneueh jeuet ngui \. Contoh: Field1 == I\'m. Droeneueh jeuet gabong le kondisi. Contoh: F1 == V1 || F1 == V2. Ngon setelan awai, mandum operator geupeubuet nibak wie u uneuen. Droeneueh jeuet ubah urutan ngon boh tanda kurong. Contoh: F1 == V1 && ( F2 == V2 || F2 == V3 ). Droeneueh jeuet mita ruang teks ngon regex: F1 == /Tes.*/i
text-contains-trigger-description: Cok watèe kad geupeugöt, atawa judul atawa deskripsi jih geuubah, ngön teks barô na nyoe (hana peduli haraih rayeuk/ubit).
imported-member-no-account: Anggota geuimpor — mantong hana akun nyang cocok
impersonate-emergency: Akses darurat: peugah bak mandum admin laen jinoe
email-emergency-access-text:
__admin__ ka geunguy akses darurat keu tamong sabagoe __user__ bak __url__ watee __time__.

Sabab: __note__

Mandum nyang geupeubuet lam watee nyan na lam Panel Admin / Ureueng / Log Audit ngon Masalah / Laporan Peuniru.
import-board-instruction-kanboard: Tempel JSON ekspor Kanboard: saboh objek ngon "columns" (atawa tasks nyang ba column_name) ngön array "tasks" (title, description, column_name, swimlane_name, date_due, owner, tags). Kolom jadi dapeuta ngön task jadi kad.
import-board-instruction-deck: Tempel JSON papan NextCloud Deck (saboh papan ngon "stacks", tiep stack ba "cards" jih). Stack jadi dapeuta ngön cards jadi kad.
import-board-instruction-openproject: Tempel JSON koleksi work-packages OpenProject (GET /api/v3/work_packages). Status jadi dapeuta ngön work package jadi kad.
import-board-instruction-issues: Tempel array JSON issues __sourceName__ (__endpoint__). Issue jadi kad nyang geukumpoi lam dapeuta Open / Closed.
import-board-instruction-asana: Tempel JSON ekspor tasks Asana ({ "data": [...] } nibak ekspor Asana atawa GET /tasks). Task geukumpoi lam bagian (memberships); task nyang ka seuleusoe jak u Done.
import-board-instruction-zenkit: Tempel JSON ekspor list ZenKit ({ "title", "stages":[...], "items":[...] }). Stage jadi dapeuta ngön item jadi kad.
import-board-instruction-markdown: Tempel saboh dapeuta tugaih markdown (aturan nyang geungui lé alat markdown-kanban lagèe Obsidian Kanban): kepala "## Nan dapeuta", ngön item "- [ ]"/"- [x]" di yup jih. Kepala jeuet keu dapeuta ngön item jeuet keu kad; dapeuta biasa nyang hana kutak tanda cit jeuet geuimpor, sibagoe kad nyang goh seuleusoe.
import-board-instruction-leo: Tempel susônan Leo (fail .leo). Bagian bak tingkat paléng ateuh jeuet keu dapeuta, aneuk jih jeuet keu kad ngön isi bagian sibagoe deskripsi, ngön bagian nyang leubèh dalam jeuet keu checklist. Bagian nyang ka geuboh tanda geuimpor sibagoe nyang ka seuleusoe.
import-board-instruction-opml: Tempel garéh beusa OPML, lagee nyang geuekspor le Workflowy, Dynalist, OmniOutliner, Logseq ngon outliner laen. Item tingkat ateuh jeuet keu dapeuta, aneuk jih jeuet keu kad ngon catatan sibagoe deskripsi, ngon item nyang leubeh dalam jeuet keu checklist. Item nyang ka leusoe geuimpor sibagoe ka leusoe.
import-board-instruction-orgmode: Tempel file Org mode, lagee nyang geutuléh le Emacs, Orgzly atawa Beorg. Judul tingkat ateuh jeuet keu dapeuta ngon judul tingkat dua jeuet keu kad. TODO ngon DONE, prioritas, tag, SCHEDULED, DEADLINE ngon CLOSED geupeutheun, ngon kotak cek ngon judul nyang leubeh dalam jeuet keu checklist.
import-board-instruction-todotxt: Tempel fail todo.txt: saboh tugaih bak saboh baréh, lagèe nyang geutuléh lé aplikasi todo.txt ngön aplikasi nyang sisuai. Tugaih nyang ka seuleusoe ("x") jak u Seuleusoe, +project ngön @context jeuet keu label, (A) jeuet keu label prioritas, due: ngön t: jeuet keu tanggai tempo ngön tanggai phôn.
import-board-instruction-taskwarrior: Tempel hasé task export: saboh array JSON, atawa saboh tugaih bak tiep baréh. Tugaih nyang ka seuleusoe jak u Done, project ngön priority jeuet keu label, annotations jeuet keu komen, ngön depends jeuet keu meugantông bak tugaih nyang hambat.
import-board-instruction-focalboard: Peuhah fail .boardarchive nibak zip dan tampèe asoe board.jsonl nibak papan, ngön baréh versi atawa hana. Sifeut peusapat lam tampilan papan jeuet keu dapeuta, sifeut pilihan laén jeuet keu label, blok teks ngon kotak tanda jeuet keu peunerangan ngon dapeuta peumeriksa, dan komentar geukeubah. Gamba ngon fail lampiran hana geupeutamong.
import-board-instruction-todoist: Bak Todoist, peuhah proyek, pileh meunu ⋯ bak ateuh uneun jih, laju Manage data > Export as CSV, ngön tempel fail CSV nyan. Bagian jeuet keu dapeuta, tugaih jeuet keu kad, subtugaih jeuet keu checklist, catatan jeuet keu komen, ngön @label ngön prioritas p1 sampoe p3 jeuet keu label.
import-board-instruction-planner: Bak Microsoft Planner, peuhah rencana, pileh meunu ⋯ bak sisi nan jih, laju Export as Excel (bak Planner klasik: Export plan to Excel), ngön pileh fail .xlsx nyan. Bucket jeuet keu dapeuta ngön tugaih jeuet keu kad, ngön ureueng nyang geubri buet, tanggai, label, checklist ngön deskripsi jih; Progress, Priority ngön Completed By jeuet keu ruang khusuih.
import-board-instruction-azuredevops: Lam Azure DevOps, buka Boards, lheuh nyan Queries, jalanku query nyang peuleumah kolom nyang neutem, dan pileh Export to CSV; pileh beureukah .csv nyan. Board Column (atawa State) jeuet keu dapeuta dan Board Lane jeuet keu swimlane; work item jeuet keu kad ngon jeunih dan tag sibagoe label, Assigned To, tanggai, keterangan dan induk, dan kolom laen jeuet keu ruang khusuih.
import-board-instruction-mslists: Lam Microsoft Lists, buka dapeuta, pileh Export, lheuh nyan Export to CSV, dan pileh beureukah .csv nyan. Kolom Status (atawa Progress) jeuet keu dapeuta dan tiep item jeuet keu kad, ngon judul, keterangan, ureueng, tanggai dan tag; kolom laen jeuet keu ruang khusuih.
import-board-instruction-msproject: Lam Microsoft Project, pileh File, lheuh nyan Save As, ngon jeunih XML Format (*.xml), dan pileh beureukah nyan. Buet ringkasan jeuet keu swimlane dan buet jeuet keu kad lam Goh lom mulai, Teungoh jalan atawa Ka leusoe, ngon tanggai, catatan, sumber, buet ubit dan buet sigohlom.
import-board-instruction-outlook: Lam Outlook, tarek peusan u saboh folder bak komputer droeneuh, atawa keubah ngon File, lheuh nyan Save As, sibagoe Outlook Message Format (*.msg). Pileh saboh beureukah .msg, atawa saboh .zip nyang na beureukah .msg dan .eml. Tiep haba jeuet keu kad lam Board View / Email, ngon balasan sibagoe komen dan lampiran sibagoe beureukah.
import-board-instruction-meistertask: Bak MeisterTask, klik nan proyek, pileh Export project ngon ekspor CSV, lheuh nyan tempel. Bagian jeuet keu dapeuta ngon tugaih jeuet keu kad, ngon catatan, uroe bataih, ureueng geutugaih ngon tag jih; tugaih nyang ka leusoe tetap na tanggal leusoe jih. CSV nyang geutuléh keu impor MeisterTask keudroe pih jeuet.
import-board-instruction-obsidian: Bak Obsidian, buka file papan Kanban sibagoe Markdown (atawa buka file .md bak editor teks), lheuh nyan tempel bandum. Lajôr jeuet keu dapeuta ngon bataih kad jih, kad tetap na tag, tanggal, prioritas, ruang ngon checklist jih, ngon Arsip jeuet keu kad nyang ka geuarsip.
import-board-instruction-linear: Bak Linear, ekspor isu sibagoe CSV (Settings, Import / Export, Export data, atawa ekspor saboh view), lheuh nyan tempel CSV. Status jeuet keu dapeuta, tim jeuet keu jalur, ngon isu jeuet keu kad ngon ureueng geutugaih, label, tanggal, isu induk, prioritas, peukira, proyek ngon siklus jih.
import-board-instruction-ticktick: Bak TickTick, buka Settings, Account, Backup & Import ngon peugöt cadangan, lheuh nyan tempel file CSV. Tiep dapeuta TickTick jeuet keu jalur ngon kolom jih jeuet keu dapeuta; tugaih tetap na tag, tanggal, checklist, prioritas ngon subtugas jih.
import-board-instruction-clickup: Bak ClickUp, ekspor tugaih sibagoe CSV (Settings, Imports / Exports, Export Items, atawa ekspor view List atawa Table ngon bandum kolom), lheuh nyan tempel CSV. Status jeuet keu dapeuta, dapeuta ClickUp jeuet keu jalur, ngon tugaih jeuet keu kad ngon subtugas, ureueng geutugaih, tag, tanggal, prioritas ngon watèe jih.
import-board-instruction-nullboard: Bak Nullboard, buka papan, pileh Export this board... nibak menu, buka file .nbx bak editor teks ngon tempel isi jih. Dapeuta jeuet keu dapeuta ngon catatan jeuet keu kad: baréh phon catatan jeuet keu judul kad ngon sisa jih jeuet keu deskripsi. Catatan mentah meuteumee label raw. File ngon padum boh papan geuimpor papan phon jih.
import-board-instruction-kanri: Bak Kanri, buka Import & Export ngon pileh Export individual board (atawa Export all data), lheuh nyan tempel file .json. Kolom jeuet keu dapeuta ngon kad jeuet keu kad, ngon deskripsi, uroe bataih, tag ngon warna jih; tugaih bak kad jeuet keu checklist. Nibak ekspor bandum data, papan phon nyang geuimpor.
import-board-instruction-planka: Tuléh alamat Planka droeneuh (contoh https://planka.example.com), nan ureueng ngui ngon kata sandi Planka droeneuh, lheuh nyan teukan Peuleumah Dapeuta. Nyan cit geungui keu peucok papan mantong dan hana geukeubah. Pileh saboh papan dan teukan Cok: WeKan geubaca nibak API Planka, ngon dapeuta, kad, deskripsi, uroe bataih, label, anggota, dapeuta buet ngon komen jih, lheuh nyan lanjut impor lagée biasa. Kad lam arsip Planka geuimpor lam keadaan teuarsip; lampiran ngon kad lam tong sampah hana geuimpor.
import-board-instruction-mstodo: Lam Microsoft Graph Explorer (developer.microsoft.com/graph/graph-explorer), tamöng, peutuju izin Tasks.Read dan salén token nibak tab Access token. Tempel keunoe dan klik Peuleumah Dapeuta; token nyan geungui keu peucok nyoe mantong dan hana geukeubah. Pileh mandum dapeuta atawa saboh dapeuta dan klik Cok. Tiep dapeuta To Do jeuet keu dapeuta dan tiep buet jeuet keu kad, ngon catatan, uroe bataih ngon uroe phôn, langkah sibagoe dapeuta peumeriksa, kategori sibagoe label, dan keupeunténg manyang ngon status sibagoe label; buet nyang ka leusoe geupinah u arsip. Peuingat ngon ulang hana geuimpor.
import-board-instruction-onenote: Lam Microsoft Graph Explorer (developer.microsoft.com/graph/graph-explorer), tamöng, peutuju izin Notes.Read dan salén token nibak tab Access token. Tempel keunoe dan klik Peuleumah Dapeuta; token nyan geungui keu peucok nyoe mantong dan hana geukeubah. Pileh saboh buku catatan dan klik Cok. Bagian jeuet keu dapeuta dan halaman jeuet keu kad, ngon teks, kotak to-do sibagoe dapeuta peumeriksa dan subhalaman sibagoe buet ubit.
import-board-instruction-teams: Tempel saboh token akses Microsoft Graph ngon Chat.Read (nibak Graph Explorer, akun keurija atawa sikula) dan klik Peuleumah Dapeuta, lheuh nyan pileh saboh chat atawa saluran dan klik Cok; token hana geukeubah. Atawa pileh beureukah: .tar ekspor pribadi droeneuh nibak teams.live.com/dataexport, atawa .json peusan chat. Tiep chat jeuet keu kad lam Board View / Chat, peusan jih jeuet keu komen.
import-board-instruction-sandstorm: Lam Sandstorm, buka grain __app__, piléh Download backup bak bar ateuh grain, laju piléh fail .zip nyan. Asoe grain jeut keu papan, item-item jih jeut keu kad deungon peue nyang geukeubah lé aplikasi. Piléh aplikasi nyang punya grain nyan: grain nibak aplikasi laen geutulak, dan geupeugah aplikasi peue nyan.
import-board-instruction-kanbanflow: Lam KanbanFlow, buka menu papan, pileh Settings → API & Webhooks dan salén token API papan. Tempel token keunoe, klik Peuleumah Dapeuta, pileh papan dan klik Cok; token nyan geungui keu peucok nyan mantong dan hana geukeubah. Kolom jeuet keu dapeuta dan jalur teutap jalur; buet teutap ngon deskripsi, warna, label, uroe bataih, subbuet sibagoe dapeuta peumeriksa, watée nyang ka geungui, perkiraan, ureueng dan komen jih.
import-board-instruction-basecamp: Tuléh ID akun Basecamp droeneuh (angka lheuh basecamp.com/ lam alamat) ngon saboh token akses (nibak aplikasi OAuth 2 nyang geudaftar bak launchpad.37signals.com, atawa nyang ka na bak integrasi nyang ka na), klik Peuleumah Dapeuta, pileh saboh proyek dan klik Cok. Token nyan geungui keu peucok nyan mantong dan hana geukeubah. Tiep tabel kad jeuet keu jalur ngon kolom jih sibagoe dapeuta, dan dapeuta buet jeuet keu jalur To-dos; kad ngon buet teutap ngon teks, uroe, ureueng nyang geutunjôk ngon komen jih, langkah kad jeuet keu dapeuta peumeriksa, dan buet nyang ka leusoe geupinah u arsip.
import-board-instruction-googletasks: Cok token akses nibak OAuth 2.0 Playground: di yup Tasks API v1 pileh tasks.readonly, klik Authorize APIs, lheuh nyan Exchange authorization code for tokens, dan salén token akses. Tempel keunoe dan klik Peuleumah Dapeuta, pileh mandum dapeuta buet atawa sa, lheuh nyan Cok. Token nyan geungui keu peucok nyoe mantong dan hana geukeubah. Dapeuta buet jeuet keu dapeuta dan buet jeuet keu kad, ngon catatan, link ngon uroe bataih jih; subbuet jeuet keu dapeuta peumeriksa dan buet nyang ka leusoe geuimpor lam keadaan teuarsip.
import-board-instruction-googlekeep: API Google Keep keu akun Google Workspace mantong. Cok token akses OAuth 2.0 ngon cakupan https://www.googleapis.com/auth/keep.readonly (lam OAuth 2.0 Playground meunyoe admin Workspace droeneuh geuizin, atawa nibak akun layanan ngon delegasi saban domain), tempel, klik Peuleumah Dapeuta dan lheuh nyan Cok. Token nyan geungui keu peucok nyoe mantong dan hana geukeubah. Catatan teks jeuet keu kad lam dapeuta Catatan, dan catatan dapeuta peumeriksa jeuet keu kad lam dapeuta Dapeuta ngon item jih sibagoe dapeuta peumeriksa. Catatan lam tong sampah, lampiran ngon bagi hana geuimpor.
api-import-desc: Cok nibak layanan ngon akun droeneuh keudroe. Peue nyang droeneuh tuléh keunoe geungui keu peucok nyoe mantong dan hana geukeubah.
api-import-list: Peuleumah Dapeuta peue nyang jeuet geuimpor
api-import-fetched: Ka geucok. Kalon anggota di yup dan impor.
api-import-nothing: Hana peue nyang jeuet geuimpor ngon akun nyoe.
import-board-instruction-pivotal: Bak Pivotal Tracker, buka tab MORE proyek ngon pileh Export CSV (atawa pileh story ngon pileh Bulk Actions, CSV), lheuh nyan tempel CSV. Tiep keuadaan story jeuet keu dapeuta ngon story jeuet keu kad, ngon jeunèh ngon label, ureueng po, ureueng lakée, tanggal, komen, tugaih ngon peuhambat jih; Estimate jeuet keu Story points ngon iterasi jeuet keu sprint.
import-board-instruction-tasksorg: Bak Tasks.org, buka Settings, Backups ngon pileh Export tasks, lheuh nyan tempel isi file .json nyan. Dapeuta jeuet keu dapeuta ngon tugaih jeuet keu kad, ngon catatan, tag, tanggal, komen ngon subtugas jih; tugaih nyang ka leusoe tetap na tanggal leusoe jih, ngon prioritas jeuet keu ruang khusus.
import-board-instruction-monday: Bak monday.com, buka menu papan, pileh More actions ngon Export board to Excel (ngon updates ngon subitems meunyoe neutem), lheuh nyan pileh file .xlsx nyan. Kolom Status jeuet keu dapeuta ngon kelompok jeuet keu jalur; ureueng, tanggal, timeline ngon tag tetap bak teumpat jih, kolom laen jeuet keu ruang khusus ngon updates jeuet keu komen.
import-board-instruction-superproductivi: Bak Super Productivity, buka Settings, lheuh nyan Sync & Backup, pileh Export Data ngon tempel isi file .json sp-backup. Tiep proyek jeuet keu jalur ngon tugaih jeuet keu kad bak To Do, In Progress, Backlog atawa Done, ngon catatan, tag, uroe bataih, watèe nyang ka geungui ngon subtugas jih; tugaih nyang ka geuarsip jeuet keu kad nyang ka geuarsip.
import-board-instruction-taiga: Bak Taiga, buka Admin > Project > Export ngon unduh dump proyek (buka phon file .json.gz), lheuh nyan tempel JSON jih. Status user story jeuet keu dapeuta, user story jeuet keu kad ngon tugaih jih sibagoe subtugas, epic ngon isu meuteumee jalur keudroe, ngon sprint, tag, komen ngon atribut khusus pih ikot. Lampiran h'an geuimpor.
import-board-instruction-vikunja: Bak Vikunja, buka Settings, pileh Data Export ngon unduh file .zip nyang geukirém u droeneueh, lheuh nyan pileh file nyan, atawa tempel data.json nyang na lam jih. Ember Kanban jeuet keu dapeuta ngon tugaih jeuet keu kad, ngon label, ureueng geutugaih, tanggal, deskripsi, dapeuta tugaih sibagoe checklist ngon komen jih; prioritas, persen leusoe ngon leusoe jeuet keu ruang khusus. Lampiran h'an geuimpor.
import-board-instruction-quire: Bak Quire, buka menu proyek ngon pileh Export CSV, lheuh nyan tempel CSV. Status jeuet keu dapeuta ngon tugaih jeuet keu kad, ngon subtugas jih sibagoe kad aneuk, ureueng geutugaih, tag sibagoe label, tanggal phon, bataih ngon leusoe, deskripsi ngon prioritas sibagoe ruang khusus. Komen ngon lampiran hana lam CSV Quire.
import-board-instruction-wrike: Bak Wrike, ekspor proyek atawa map u Excel, atawa peupeunoh templat impor Excel Wrike, lheuh nyan pileh file .xlsx nyan. Baréh map ngon proyek jeuet keu jalur, Status jeuet keu dapeuta ngon tugaih jeuet keu kad, ngon Key, tugaih induk, ureueng geutugaih, tanggal phon ngon akhé, ketergantungan ngon deskripsi jih; Priority, Duration ngon kolom laen jeuet keu ruang khusus.
import-board-instruction-teamwork: Bak Teamwork.com, peupeunoh templat impor tugaih Excel (Tasklist, Task, Description, Assign to, Start date, Due date, Priority, Estimated time, Tags, Status) ngon keubah sibagoe .xlsx, lheuh nyan pileh file nyan. Dapeuta tugaih jeuet keu dapeuta ngon tugaih jeuet keu kad; tugaih nyang geupeuphon ngon -, # atawa > jeuet keu subtugas nibak tugaih di ateuh jih (--, ## atawa >> saboh tingkat leubeh dalam). Ureueng geutugaih, tanggal ngon tag tetap bak teumpat jih; Priority, Estimated time ngon Complete jeuet keu ruang khusus.
import-board-instruction-businessmap: Bak Businessmap (dilee Kanbanize), buka Advanced Search, pileh Configure results keu pileh kolom, unduh file Excel, lheuh nyan pileh file .xlsx nyan. Kolom geubaca ngon nan Inggreh jih (Title, Column, Lane, Owner, Deadline ...): meunyoe akun droeneueh jingui bahsa laen, ganto phon nan baréh kepala u bahsa Inggreh. Column jeuet keu dapeuta ngon Lane jeuet keu jalur; ureueng po, tag, warna, tanggal, komen ngon link induk tetap bak teumpat jih, ngon Priority, Size, Type ngon kolom laen jeuet keu ruang khusus.
import-board-instruction-redmine: Bak Redmine, buka Issues proyek, pileh Also available in: CSV bak bagian bawah dapeuta, pileh kolom (All columns, ngon Description) ngon ekspor, lheuh nyan tempel CSV. Redmine geubri nan kolom lam bahsa droeneueh, nyan pasai atô bahsa droeneueh u bahsa Inggreh bak My account sigohlom ekspor. Tiep status jeuet keu dapeuta ngon isu jeuet keu kad, ngon tracker sibagoe label, ureueng geutugaih, ureueng tuléh, tanggal, tugaih induk ngon isu meuhubong; prioritas, kategori, versi tujuan, watèe peukira, % Done ngon ruang khusus jeuet keu ruang khusus.
import-board-instruction-notion: Bak Notion, buka database sibagoe on peunoh, pileh ••• ngon Export, pileh Markdown & CSV, ngon pileh file .zip nyang geuunduh, atawa saboh CSV database nibak nyan, atawa tempel CSV nyan. Kolom ngon nan Status jeuet keu dapeuta (meunyoe hana, kolom phon nyang lagee pileh jeuet keu dapeuta, ngon laporan impor geupeugah kolom pat); baréh jeuet keu kad ngon judul, tag sibagoe label, ureueng sibagoe anggota, tanggal, ngon teks on sibagoe deskripsi; kolom laen jeuet keu ruang khusus. Hubongan, gamba ngon lampiran h'an geuimpor.
import-board-instruction-plane: Bak Plane, buka Workspace Settings, pileh Exports, ekspor proyek sibagoe JSON, CSV atawa Excel ngon unduh file .zip, lheuh nyan pileh file nyan, atawa saboh file nibak dalam jih, atawa tempel JSON atawa CSV. Keuadaan jeuet keu dapeuta, proyek jeuet keu jalur, ngon isu jeuet keu kad ngon tanda, induk, ureueng geutugaih, label, tanggal, link ngon komen jih; prioritas, peukira, siklus ngon modul jeuet keu ruang khusus. Ekspor Plane hana deskripsi atawa lampiran, nyan pasai h'an geuimpor.
import-board-instruction-fizzy: Bak Fizzy, ekspor akun bak "Account settings", atawa kad droeneuh mandiri ngon "Download my data", lheuh nyan pilèh fail .zip nyang geukirim lé Fizzy keu droeneuh, atawa fail .json saboh kad. Panel jeuet keu swimlane ngon kolom jeuet keu dapeuta, ngon "Maybe?", "Not now" ngon "Done" lagée bak Fizzy; kad teutap na deskripsi, label, ureueng geutugaih, langkah sibagoe dapeuta peureksa, komen ngon fail jih.
import-board-instruction-mail: Pilèh fail .mbox, lagèe nyang geukeubah lé Thunderbird, Apple Mail, mutt atawa Gmail meulalui Google Takeout, atawa saboh pesan .eml, atawa tamp teks jih. Tiep-tiep haba jeuet keu saboh kad lam dapeuta Inbox, ngon peukirém, peuneurimong ngon pokok haba jih, mangat jeuet deuh lam ngon Email; balasan jeuet keu komen jih. Label Gmail jeuet keu label. Lampiran hana geuimpor.
import-board-instruction-ical: Pilèh fail almanak .ics, lagèe nyang geu-ekspor lé Google Calendar, Apple Calendar atawa Reminders, Thunderbird, Nextcloud atawa Outlook, atawa tamp teks jih. Tugaih jak u To Do, In Progress, Done atawa Cancelled meunurôt status jih, ngon acara u Events, ngon tanggai phôn ngon bataih watèë jih, mangat deuh lam ngon Calendar ngon Gantt. Kategori ngon prioritas jeuet keu label. Item nyang meuulang geuimpor sigoe mantong.
import-board-instruction-googletakeout: Bak takeout.google.com, pilèh Tasks, Keep, Mail, Calendar ngon Google Chat, peugöt ekspor ngon unduh fail .zip, lheueh nyan pilèh fail nyan sinoe. Tiep-tiep produk jeuet keu saboh swimlane: surat keu ngon Email, dapeuta tugaih ngon cataan ngon dapeuta peureksa jih, acara almanak ngon tugaih ngon tanggai, ngon ruang chat nyang pesan jih jeuet keu komen keu ngon Chat. Produk laén ngon lampiran hana geuimpor.
import-board-instruction-slack: Lam Slack, buka pengaturan ruang keurija, pilèh Import/Export Data, ekspor ruang keurija ngon unduh fail .zip, lheueh nyan pilèh fail nyan sinoe. Tiep-tiep saluran jeuet keu saboh kad lam Channels, Groups atawa Direct messages, ngon pesan ngon balasan utah jih jeuet keu komen kad, meunurôt peunuléh jih, mangat ngon Chat peudeuh saluran nyan. Fail hana geuimpor.
import-board-instruction-mattermost: Ekspor ngon mmctl export create, unduh ekspor nyan ngon pilèh fail .jsonl jih, atawa tamp teks jih. Tiep-tiep saluran ngon pesan langsông jeuet keu saboh kad, ngon postingan ngon balasan jih jeuet keu komen kad, mangat ngon Chat peudeuh saluran nyan. Tim jeuet keu swimlane. Fail hana geuimpor.
import-board-instruction-telegram: Lam Telegram Desktop, buka Settings, Advanced, Export Telegram data, pilèh format JSON ngon ekspor, lheueh nyan pilèh fail result.json, atawa tamp teks jih. Tiep-tiep chat jeuet keu saboh kad lam Direct messages, Groups atawa Channels, ngon pesan jih jeuet keu komen kad, mangat ngon Chat peudeuh chat nyan. Foto ngon fail hana geuimpor.
import-board-instruction-whatsapp: Lam WhatsApp, buka chat, pilèh Export chat hana media, ngon pilèh fail .txt sinoe, atawa tamp teks jih. Chat nyan jeuet keu saboh kad nyang pesan jih jeuet keu komen, meunurôt peukirém ngon watèë jih, mangat ngon Chat peudeuh chat nyan. Media ngon pesan sistem hana geuimpor.
import-board-instruction-discord: Ekspor saboh saluran Discord ngon DiscordChatExporter lam format JSON ngon pilèh fail .json, atawa tamp teks jih. Saluran nyan jeuet keu saboh kad lam kategori jih, ngon pesan jih jeuet keu komen kad, mangat ngon Chat peudeuh saluran nyan. Server jeuet keu swimlane. Lampiran hana geuimpor.
import-board-instruction-rocketchat: Bak Rocket.Chat, ekspor data droeneuh sibagoe JSON bak "My Data" ngon pilèh fail .zip nyang geukirim keu droeneuh, atawa fail .json nyang geuekspor nibak saboh ruang. Tiep-tiep ruang jeuet keu saboh kad ngon pesan jih jeuet keu komen kad, mangat ngon Chat peudeuh ruang nyan. Fail .zip nyang geuekspor lé WeKan keu pengimpor CSV Rocket.Chat geubaca cit.
import-board-instruction-evernote: Lam Evernote, ekspor cataan atawa saboh buku cataan sibagoe fail .enex ngon pilèh fail nyan sinoe, atawa tamp teks jih. Tiep-tiep cataan jeuet keu saboh kad ngon teks jih, kotak to-do jih sibagoe dapeuta peureksa, tag jih sibagoe label ngon peuingat jih sibagoe bataih watèë; cataan nyang peuingat jih ka seuleusoe jak u Done. Gamba ngon fail lampiran hana geuimpor.
import-board-instruction-trello: Bak papan Trello droeneueh, buka 'Menu', lheueh nyan 'More', 'Print and Export', 'Export JSON', ngon salin teks hasil jih.

import-board-instruction-jira: Tempel JSON nibak mita issue Jira Cloud: GET /rest/api/3/search/jql?jql=project=KEY&fields=*all&expand=names,schema (hana fields geuwoe id issue mantong). Proyek rayeuk teuka meu-laman, tiep laman ngön nextPageToken keu laman lheueh nyan: peutamong issue nibak mandum laman lam saboh array "issues", atawa impor tiep laman sibagoe papan droe jih ngön Impor le papan. Objek { "issues": [...] } nyang saban cit jeuet. Status Jira jeuet keu dapeuta ngön issue jeuet keu kad. Meunyoe hawa, peutamong array "automationRules" keu impor aturan.

globalSearch-instructions-description: Mita jeuet na operator keu peucok hasé mita. Operator geutuléh ngön nan operator ngön nilè nyang geupeuceurai lé titek dua. Umpama, operator `list:Blocked` bataih mita bak kad nyang na lam dapeuta nan *Blocked*. Meunyoe nilè na spasi atawa karakter khusus, beu geupeuduek lam tanda petik (umpama `__operator_list__:"To Review"`).
globalSearch-instructions-operator-board: `__operator_board__:<title>` - kad lam papan nyang cocok ngon *<title>*
globalSearch-instructions-operator-list: `__operator_list__:<title>` - kad lam senarai nyang cocok ngon *<title>*
globalSearch-instructions-operator-swiml: `__operator_swimlane__:<title>` - kad lam swimlane nyang cocok ngon *<title>*
globalSearch-instructions-operator-comme: `__operator_comment__:<text>` - kad ngon saboh komen nyang na *<text>*.
globalSearch-instructions-operator-label: `__operator_label__:<color>` `__operator_label__:<name>` - kad nyang na label nyang cocok ngon *<color>* atawa *<name>
globalSearch-instructions-operator-org: `__operator_org__:<display name|short name>` - kad milik papan nyang geutetapkan bak organisasi *<name>*
globalSearch-instructions-operator-team: `__operator_team__:<display name|short name>` - kad milik papan nyang geutetapkan bak tim *<name>*
globalSearch-instructions-operator-due: `__operator_due__:<n>` - kad nyang tempo hingga *<n>* uroe nibak jinoe. `__operator_due__:__predicate_overdue__ peudeuih mandum kad nyang ka leupah tanggal tempo.
globalSearch-instructions-operator-creat: `__operator_created__:<n>` - kad nyang geupeugot *<n>* uroe ka leupah atawa kureueng
globalSearch-instructions-operator-modif: `__operator_modified__:<n>` - kad nyang geuubah *<n>* uroe ka leupah atawa kureueng
globalSearch-instructions-status-all: `__predicate_all__` - mandum kad nyang geuarsip ngön nyang hana geuarsip
globalSearch-instructions-operator-has: `__operator_has__:<field>` - nyang *<field>* saboh nibak `__predicate_attachment__`, `__predicate_checklist__`, `__predicate_description__`, `__predicate_start__`, `__predicate_due__`, `__predicate_end__`, `__predicate_assignee__` atawa `__predicate_member__`. Peuduek `-` di keue *<field>* keu cari nyang hana na nila bak ruang nyan (umpama `has:-due` cari kad nyang hana tanggal tempo).
globalSearch-instructions-operator-sort: `__operator_sort__:<sort-name>` - nyang *<sort-name>* saboh nibak `__predicate_due__`, `__predicate_created__` atawa `__predicate_modified__`. Keu susun meunuron, peuduek `-` di keue nama susun.
globalSearch-instructions-operator-limit: `__operator_limit__:<n>` - nyang *<n>* angka bulat positif nyang peunyata jumlah kad nyang geupeudeuh tiep halaman.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-2:
Operator nyang saban geupeu-*OR*. Kad nyang cocok ngon barang saboh syarat geupeuwoe.
`__operator_list__:Available __operator_list__:Blocked` peuwoe kad nyang na lam dapeuta nan *Blocked* atawa *Available*.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-3: Operator nyang beda geupeu-*AND*. Mantong kad nyang cocok ngön mandum operator nyang beda nyang geupeuwoe. `__operator_list__:Available __operator_label__:red` peuwoe mantong kad lam dapeuta *Available* ngön label *red*.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-3-2: Uroe jeuet geutuléh lagèe angka bulat positif atawa negatif, atawa ngui `__predicate_week__`, `__predicate_month__`, `__predicate_quarter__` atawa `__predicate_year__` keu masa jinoe.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-4: Pencarian teks hana beda huruf rayek ngon huruf ubit.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-5: Ngon setelan awai, kad lam Arsip hana geumita.

login-refused-ldap-not-in-allowed-group: Hana lam kawan direktori nyang jeuet ngui WeKan
login-refused-ldap-not-in-allowed-group-: Tamah ureueng nyan u kawan nyan lam direktori, atawa ubah saréng kawan bak Ureueng / LDAP.
login-refused-ldap-account-not-linked: Akun WeKan ngon nan nyan hana meusambông ngon direktori
login-refused-ldap-account-not-linked-fi: Pasang LDAP_MERGE_EXISTING_USERS=true mangat meusambông watée tamong lheueh nyoe, bak Ureueng / LDAP.

office-report-desc: Dipat ureung tamong, geuklompok meunurot ureung. Tiep alamat IPv4 atawa IPv6 peuleumah nanggroe, banda, ngon jeumeulah tamong nyang meuhase.

api-report-desc: Titik akhe REST API toh nyang geungui, le soe, ngon padum kayém. Saboh bareh keu saboh akun ngon titik akhe, meusajan masa nyang geulipôt; kon saboh bareh keu tiep lakee.
api-no-calls: Hana hoi REST API nyang geureukam. API geupeumate meunyoe kon WITH_API=true.
recovery-report-desc: Buet otomatis keu keuamanan ngon peu-ubat data: meurumpok karusakan, saleunan data teks, peuulang, peupinah lom nibak MongoDB, ngon peu-ubat otomatis pangkalan data nyang meukembang.
recovery-no-events: Hana peuristiwa peuulang nyang geucatat. Pangkalan data seuhat.
recovery-maintenance-note: Neupreh ilée — laman nyoe teuma jalan otomatis meunyoe peuulang ka seuleusoe.

mongodb-compact-description: Lheueh pinah file u luwa nibak MongoDB GridFS, file database bak disk hana meuubit keudroe. Peujalan Compact peuwoe ruang nyang ka soh ngön tuléh lom data koleksi. Peujalan nyoe mantong lheueh pinah file borongan ka seuleusoe.
mongodb-compact-warning: Peuingat: Compact nakeuh buet nyang meuhambat nyang jeuet meuploh menit bak database rayeuk. Bak replica set, mandum secondary geucompact phôn (keudroe), laju primary. Bak replica set saboh node keu oplog (setup Meteor biasa), mantong primary nyang geucompact.
mongodb-compact-running: Peujalan compact, nyoe jeuet meuploh menit...
mongodb-compact-success: Compact ka seuleusoe. Koleksi nyang geucompact:

password-pwned: Kata sandi nyoe ka meutamöng lam bocoran data. Pileh nyang laen.
password-too-short: Kata sandi beu paleng kureung __min__ karakter.
password-length-report-desc: Akun nyang tamong ngön kata sandi nyang leubeh paneuk nibak panyang paleng kureung. Cit browser mantong nyang tuphö padum panyang kata sandi, maka jih jilapor kata sandi nyang paneuk lheuh tamong; kata sandi ngön panyang jih hana tom teubiet nibak browser. Ka geupeugot meunyo kata sandi akun ka geu-ubah - akun nyang tamong lom ngön kata sandi paneuk geupeuleumah lom sibagoe paneuk that.
password-length-filter-fixed: Ka geupeugot keu kata sandi nyang cukôp panyang
password-min-length-description: Tamong ngön kata sandi nyang leubeh paneuk geupeuleumah di yup nyoe. Tamong hana tom geutolak keu nyan.
password-min-length-enforce-description: Kata sandi barô nyang leubeh paneuk geutolak, ngön akun nyang tamong ngön kata sandi leubeh paneuk wajeb jiubah dilee sigohlom nyang laen. Meng-ubah jih jiteubiet mandum sesi akun. Kata sandi LDAP, OAuth2, OIDC, SAML, CAS ngön Sandstorm nyan milek penyedia jih, ngön hana geuperiksa.
password-length-from-environment: Nilai nyang geupasang lam lingkungan server teungöh beurlaku; keubah disinoe jigantoe nyan.
password-change-required-text: Situs nyoe jinoe jilakee kata sandi paleng kureung __min__ karakter, ngön kata sandi droeneuh leubeh paneuk. Pileh nyang leubeh panyang mangat jeuet lanjut. Mandum sesi akun droeneuh laju geuteubiet, ngön droeneuh tamong lom ngön kata sandi barô.
password-same-as-username: Kata sandi bek sama ngon nan ureueng ngui atawa alamat emel.

accounts-lockout-known-users: Peuatôran keu ureueng ngui nyang geuturi (nan ureueng ngui beutôi, sandi salah)
accounts-lockout-unknown-users: Peuatôran keu ureueng ngui nyang hana geuturi (nan ureueng ngui nyang hana na)
accounts-lockout-settings-updated: Peuatôran peulindông brute force ka geuubah
data-access-info: Soe yang peutrön peu: tiap ekspor papan, ekspor mandum papan, data ureueng atawa daftar Panel Admin, dikira per ureueng ngon per uroe.
compliance-info: Peuatôran nyang paléng kayém geuhareutoe lé GDPR, HIPAA, NIS2, ISO 27001 ngon SOC 2. Halaman nyoe cit geulapor mantong: nyang peunténg nibak nyan meunurôt soe nyang jalankan WeKan nyoe ngon keu soe.
compliance-2fa-admins: Otentikasi dua faktor geuwajéb, paléng kureung keu admin
compliance-login-retention: Alamat tamöng geukeubah keu watée nyang teubatah
compliance-audit-retention: Log audit geukeubah 2190 uroe atawa leubèh (HIPAA)
compliance-imprint-published: Informasi peunerbit ka geupeuteubiet (geuwajéb keu layanan komersial di Jerman ngon Austria)
compliance-security-contact: Kontak keamanan ka geuatô, keu security.txt
admin-audit-log-info: Peue nyang geupeubuet lé peungatô situs: meurubah ureueng ngui, tamöng, keubah data ngon saleunan, nyang barô phon. Kata sandi ngon rahsia hana tom geucatat. Geukeubah sithon.

s3-force-path-style-description: Geupeureulee lé MinIO ngön le that server kompatibel S3 nyang kon AWS.
s3-sse-description: S3 geu-enkripsi bandum lampiran, avatar ngon saleunan nyang geutuléh lé WeKan, ngon geubuka enkripsi keu WeKan watèe geubaca.
s3-sse-kms-key-id: ID kunci KMS keu SSE-KMS (soh = kunci standar akun)
azure-connection-string-description: Pileh-pileh: ngui connection string leungkap ganti nan akun ngön gunci.
database-migration-description: Migrasi data teks (mandum keucuali lampiran ngön avatar, nyang tinggai bak filesystem) antara MongoDB ngön FerretDB v1 (SQLite). Database laén wajéb teungoh jalan ngön jeuet geuhubông (port default: FerretDB mongodb://127.0.0.1:27018, MongoDB mongodb://127.0.0.1:27019; ubah ngön WEKAN_FERRETDB_URL / WEKAN_MONGODB_URL). Lheueh seuleusoe, tunyok MONGO_URL u database laén laju phôn lom WeKan (bak Snap: snap set wekan database=ferretdb atawa =mongodb).
database-migrate-to-ferretdb: Migrasi data teks u FerretDB v1 (SQLite)
database-migration-confirm: Salén mandum koleksi teks u __db__? Lampiran ngön avatar bak filesystem hana meuubah. Database tujuan wajéb teungoh jalan.
sandstorm-migration-description: Watèe WeKan jalan lam grain Sandstorm, database MongoDB 3 awai jih geumigrasi u FerretDB v1 (SQLite) bak phôn geupeujalan, laju lampiran ngön avatar geupinah nibak database u direktori files/attachments ngön files/avatars grain. Nyoe peuleumah peue migrasi nyan meuhasé ngön padum ruang disk nyang mantong geungui lé file database MongoDB meuntah nyang awai lam grain, ngön bri droeneueh jeuet hapus file meuntah nyan keu peusoh ruang.
sandstorm-delete-raw-mongodb: Hapus fail pangkalan data MongoDB meuntah
sandstorm-delete-raw-mongodb-description: Lheueh migrasi meuhasé, data na bak FerretDB ngön bak filesystem, nyan sebab file database MongoDB 3 meuntah nyang awai jeuet geuhapus keu peusoh ruang disk grain. Nyoe hana jeuet geupeuwoe.
sandstorm-delete-raw-mongodb-confirm: Hapus file database MongoDB 3 meuntah keu peusoh ruang disk? Data ka geumigrasi u FerretDB ngön filesystem. Nyoe hana jeuet geupeuwoe.
sandstorm-raw-mongodb-deleted: File database MongoDB meuntah ka geuhapus, ruang nyang ka soh
features-desc: Fitur piléhan nyang geubri lé WeKan. Fitur nyang hana geutanda geupeusöm nibak layar mandum ureueng ngui. Data jih teukeubah, idin hana meuubah.
feature-views-table-desc: Papan lagee tabel kad nyang jeuet geuatoe.
feature-views-calendar-desc: Kalèndè ngon kalèndè keu jai papan.
feature-views-overview-desc: Angka, peusapat meunurot ureuëng nyang geubri buet, rencana buet, papan kontrol ngon papan raya.
feature-views-scrum-desc: Daftar buet produk nyang mantöng na, masa buet paneuk, laporan masa nyan ngon bagah buet.
feature-views-flow-charts-desc: Buet nyang mantöng na, buet nyang ka lheuh, aliran nyang teukumpôi, watèe peubuet ngon watèe nibak peumintaan sampoe lheuh, jeumeulah buet nyang ka lheuh, trep buet preh, halangan, Monte Carlo ngon ukuran aliran laén.
feature-views-map-desc: Kad lagee tanda bak gamba nyang ka geupeuek.
feature-approval-required: Peubiyeu fitur nyang geutamah lé peubarô WeKan hana aktip sampoe admin geupeuaktip
feature-preview-admins: Admin geukalon fitur nyang hana aktip keu geucuba dilèe
feature-pilot-users: Ureuëng cuba nyang jeuet cit kalon fitur nyang hana aktip
feature-pilot-users-placeholder: Nan ureuëng ngui, peupisah ngon koma
feature-profiles-desc: Saboh profil geupeusöm fitur nyang ka geupiléh nibak ureueng ngui, tim ngon organisasi nyang geubri profil nyan. Ureueng ngui geupeuthee profil pakriban nyang na bak jih. Ureueng nyang hana profil hana meupeungaruh, hana data nyang geuhapuh ngon hana izin nyang meuubah.
feature-profile-notice: Profil fitur droeneuh __name__ geupeusöm __count__ fitur. Tanyong bak admin meunyoe droeneuh peureulee salah saboh fitur nyan.
feature-pilot-users-unknown: Ka teukeubah. Nan ureuëng ngui nyoe hana meurumpok:
card-field-visibility-desc: Ruang Peuatôran Papan / Kad nyang jeuet geupeuleumah le papan. Ruang nyang h'an geucentang geusuweue nibak bandum kad, minikad ngon Peuatôran Papan / Kad bak bandum papan. Hana data kad atawa peuatôran papan nyang meuubah, ngon meunyoe geucentang lom tiep papan geupeuleumah lagee geuatô dilee. Urotan ruang nakeuh milék tiep papan.
cards-loading-auto: Otomatis (peumuat lambat keu papan rayeuk mantong)
cards-loading-description: WeKan muat kad papan keudroe: papan rayeuk (leubèh nibak bataih ukoran) muat kad nyang deuh jinoe mantong (scroll hana putôh) ngön jumeulah langsông, mangat tetap bagaih ngön ngui leubèh bacut memori ngön bandwidth, teuma papan ubit muat mandum kad keu rupa nyang paleng mudah ngön fitur leungkap. Hana peue nyang peureulee geuatô. Operator mantong jeuet paksa mode ngön variabel lingkungan CARDS_LOADING (all/lazy/auto) ngön CARDS_LOADING_LAZY_THRESHOLD.
cards-loading-lazy-note: Muat kad lazy mantong percubaan: jumeulah kad ngön bataih WIP beutôi, teuma rupa Kalèndè/Tabel/Gantt ngön pileh le mantong peuleumah kad nyang ka geumuat. Muat lom papan nyang teungoh meuhah lheueh droeneueh ubah nyoe.
render-links-as-plain-text-description: Watèe geuhudep, mandum taut (bandua taut markdown lagèe [label](url) ngön tag HTML meuntah <a href>) sabe geupeuleumah lagèe teks biasa nyang hana jeuet geuklik bak tiep ruang teks kaya (judôi papan ngön kad, deskripsi, komen, checklist, ngön laén-laén). Nyoe mangat bek na taut nyang jeuet geuklik nyang peusesat. Default maté, nyan sebab taut mantong jeuet geuklik.
always-show-code-as-text: Sabe peudeuh mandum kode lagee teks biasa
always-show-code-as-text-description: Watèe geuhudep, teks kaya hana tom geupeuleumah lagèe markdown atawa HTML: mandum sumber sabe geupeuleumah lagèe teks biasa bak tiep ruang teks kaya (judôi papan ngön kad, deskripsi, komen, checklist, ngön laén-laén). Nyoe peuleumah isi nyang teusöm — komen HTML (<!-- -->), tujuan taut markdown, JavaScript ngön kode laén — mangat mandum kode sabe deuh, hana jeuet geuklik, ngön hana jalan. Default maté, nyan sebab markdown geupeuleumah lagèe biasa.
disable-all-import-description: Watèe geuhudep, mandum fitur impor geupeumaté: impor papan nibak WeKan JSON, Trello, CSV/Excel, Jira, Kanboard, NextCloud Deck, OpenProject, GitHub, GitLab, Gitea ngön Forgejo, meunan cit clone papan. Pileh menu impor geupeusöm ngön server tulak tiep lakèe impor. Default maté.
import-max-megabytes-description: Fail paleng rayek nyang geuteurimong le laman Impor, lam megabyte. Meunyo soh, hana bateh: fail jeut rayek sigohlom ruang disk nyang lowong jeut keu impor seuleusoe. Tiep peuék geutuléh u disk server saboh bagian-saboh bagian, ngon impor nyang jeut peupeunoh disk geutulak.
import-disk-full: Ruang disk nyang lowong bak server hana gadoh keu impor nyoe.
import-upload-not-found: Fail nyang ka geupeuék hana lé. Neupileh lom.
disable-all-export-description: Watèe geuhudep, mandum fitur ekspor geupeumaté: ekspor papan lagèe WeKan JSON, CSV, Excel, Kanboard, atawa u NextCloud Deck / OpenProject / GitHub / GitLab / Gitea / Forgejo, ngön ekspor saboh lampiran. Pileh menu ekspor geupeusöm ngön server tulak tiep lakèe ekspor. Default maté.
disable-import-avatars-description: Watèe geuhudep, avatar (gamba profil ureueng ngui) hana tom geuimpor. Nyoe meuliput impor WeKan JSON, impor Trello, ngön sinkron avatar nibak provider identitas luwa watèe tamong (LDAP, OIDC/OAuth2). Nan ngön data laén mantong geuimpor; avatar mantong nyang geulangkah. Default maté.
disable-export-avatars-description: Watèe geuhudep, avatar (gamba profil ureueng ngui) hana tom geupeutamong watèe ekspor papan (ekspor WeKan JSON ngön CSV). Nan ureueng ngui ngön data laén mantong geuekspor; avatar mantong nyang hana geupeutamong. Default maté.
anonymize-import-users: Peusöm identitas ureueng ngui lam impor
anonymize-import-users-description: Watèe geuhudep, impor papan WeKan JSON geugantoe nan ureueng ngui, nan leungkap ngön inisial tiep ureueng ngui nyang geuimpor ngön placeholder meunurot numbô (user1, user2, ...), geuboh avatar jih, laju geutuléh lom sebutan @username (ngön ruang requested-by / assigned-by) lam isi kad ngön komen nyang geuimpor. Hana identitas ureueng ngui nyang beutôi nibak papan asai nyang geukeubah. Kata "user" tu'ôt bahsa ureueng nyang impor. Default maté.
anonymize-export-users: Peusom identitas ureueng ngui lam ekspor
anonymize-export-users-description: Watèe geuhudep, ekspor papan geugantoe nan ureueng ngui, nan leungkap ngön inisial tiep ureueng ngui nyang geuekspor ngön placeholder meunurot numbô (user1, user2, ...), geuboh avatar jih, laju geutuléh lom sebutan @username (ngön ruang requested-by / assigned-by) lam isi kad ngön komen. File nyang geuekspor hana geuba identitas ureueng ngui nyang beutôi. Kata "user" tu'ôt bahsa ureueng nyang ekspor. Default maté.
anonymize-account-confirm-popup: Beutôi droeneueh keuneuk peusöm identitas akun nyoe? Nyoe geugantoe keu sabe nan ureueng ngui, nan leungkap ngön alamat email ngön placeholder nyang hana identitas, geuhapus avatar, ngön geupeumaté tamong. Hana lagèe hapus, papan, kad ngön komen mantong geukeubah riwayat jih ngön mantong peuleumah akun nyoe, mantong identitas jih nyang geupeusöm. Buet nyoe hana jeuet geupeuwoe.
disable-activities-description: Watèe geuhudep, entri feed aktivitas hana tom geurekam ngön hana tom geupeuleumah pat pih (sidebar papan ngön tab aktivitas kad). Hana riwayat soe nyang peubuet peue nyang geukeubah. Default maté.
disable-notifications-description: Watèe geuhudep, WeKan hana tom kirém haba peuingat pantau (lam-app, email atawa layanan laén) keu peue mantong aktivitas. Aktivitas mantong jeuet geurekam (keucuali geupeumaté cit di ateuh); haba peuingat mantong nyang geutham. Default maté.
disable-watch-description: Watèe geuhudep, fitur pantau geupeumaté — ureueng ngui hana jeuet langganan papan, dapeuta atawa kad keu teurimong haba peuingat, ngön tiep usaha keu ubah tingkat pantau geutulak. Default maté.
backup-description: Backup Lampiran, Avatar ngön/atawa Data (mandum koleksi teks nyang kon lampiran atawa avatar). File .zip geukirém langsông u storan nyang geupileh — hana file sementara — lagèe backup/YYYY/MM/DD/HH_MM_SS/backup.zip, nyang na YYYY_MM_DD-HH_MM_SS/attachments, /avatars ngön /data. Storan cloud (S3/MinIO, Azure, GCS) ngui kredensial nyang geuatô bak tab storan jih.
backup-scope-description: Bandum instans, atawa saboh organisasi. Saleunan organisasi na papeuen jih ngön bandum nyang na bak papeuen nyan, meunan cit lampiran papeuen nyan — teuma hana akun ureueng ngui ngön hana peungatoran instans, sabab nyan geupeugot meusapat lé bandum organisasi. Peuriwang saleunan organisasi geutuléh bak papeuen milek organisasi nyan mantong.
theme-override-all-tenants: Peungatoran nyang meuguna keu mandum ureueng sewa
continuous-backup-description: Jikirém tieb-tieb peugantoe bak database, lampiran, avatar ngon catatan u saboh folder lam padum detik, mangat jeuet geupeuwoe u keadaan bak waktu toh mantong. Jimeukeureuja meusajan ngon saleunan nyang ka geuatoe jadwal, nyang jipeugot arsip peunoh.
continuous-backup-enabled: Peujak saleunan nyang hana putoh bak server nyoe
continuous-backup-target: Folder teumpat keubah (jalur peunoh, bak disk laén, teumpat keubah nyang geubagi bak jaringan atawa mount rclone)
wekan-data-no-database: Hana meuteumèe pangkai data WeKan nyang jeuet geubaca.
continuous-backup-engine-oplog: Oplog (bak waktu nyan cit, tieb-tieb peugantoe)
continuous-backup-engine-sqlite: On SQLite (on nyang ka geugantoe bak tieb-tieb sela waktu)
continuous-backup-engine-none: Hana mèsén pangkai data nyang jeuet meukeureuja bak server nyoe
continuous-backup-key-file: File gunci kode rahasia (jalur peunoh di luwa folder teumpat keubah; 64 karakter heksadesimal atawa haba rahasia nyang na paléng kureueng 16 karakter). Keubah saboh saleunan: meunyo hana file nyoe, saleunan hana jeuet geupeubalék.
continuous-backup-upload-none: Hana u teumpat toh pih (folder teumpat keubah mantong)
continuous-backup-restore-sqlite: File pangkai data SQLite (geupeugot bak bineh saleunan, hana geutuleh ateueh file nyang teungoh geungui meusigoe pih)
continuous-backup-apply-on-restart: Ngui pangkai data SQLite nyang ka geupeugot lom bak watee sistem geupeuphon lom teuma (pangkai data phon nyang geuganto teutab geukeubah)
continuous-backup-restore-confirm: Peuwoe generasi nyang geupileh u waktu nyang geupileh? Saleunan nyang hana putoh jipiyôh siat watee peumulihan teungoh jijak.
continuous-backup-saved: Peungatoeran saleunan nyang hana putoh ka teukeubah
backup-restore-select-first: Pileh saboh backup nibak daptar leubeh awai.
backup-restore-confirm: Peuwoe backup nyang geupileh? Lampiran/avatar geutuléh u filesystem ngön data u database meunurot mode nyang geupileh.
gcs-key-filename-description: Hawa: jalur u file kunci JSON akun layanan bak server.
gcs-credentials-description: Hawa: tempel kunci JSON akun peulayanan. Peukoseng keu guna file kunci atawa kredensial default.
gcs-permissions-note: Bri akun peulayanan WeKan akses beuet/tuléh u bucket: Google Cloud Console → Cloud Storage → Buckets → bucket droeneueh → Permissions → Grant access. Bak "New principals", tempel emel akun peulayanan — nilai "client_email" nibak gunci JSON droeneueh — laju pileh peran "Storage Object Admin" ngön Save.
cloud-secret-keep-blank: Peukoseng keu keubah nila nyang na jinoe.
gcs-bucket-description: Nan bucket Cloud Storage keu keubah file.
s3-endpoint-menu-path: AWS: peusoh (ngui endpoint region). Nyang kompatibel ngön S3: URL Endpoint nibak konsol MinIO / Cloudflare R2 / Backblaze B2 / Wasabi / DigitalOcean Spaces droeneueh.
s3-region-menu-path: AWS Console → S3 → Buckets → bucket droeneueh → Properties → AWS Region.
s3-bucket-menu-path: AWS Console → S3 → Buckets → nan bucket droeneueh (atawa Create bucket → Bucket name).
s3-access-key-menu-path: AWS Console → IAM → Users → ureueng ngui droeneueh → Security credentials → Access keys → Create access key → pileh use case 'Application running outside AWS' → Create access key. Geupeuleumah sabé 'Access key ID'.
s3-secret-key-menu-path: Layar saban ngön Access key ID; 'Secret access key' geupeuleumah sigoe mantong watèe gunci geupeugöt — salén watèe nyan (atawa Download .csv).
azure-account-name-menu-path: Azure Portal → Storage accounts → akun droeneueh → nan geupeudeuh di ateuh (cit di yup Security + networking → Access keys → Storage account name).
azure-account-key-menu-path: Azure Portal → Storage accounts → akun droeneueh → Security + networking → Access keys → key1 → Show → Key.
azure-connection-string-menu-path: Azure Portal → Storage accounts → akun droeneueh → Security + networking → Access keys → key1 → Connection string → Show.
azure-container-menu-path: Azure Portal → Storage accounts → akun droeneueh → Data storage → Containers → container droeneueh (atawa + Container keu peugot saboh).
gcs-project-id-menu-path: Google Cloud Console → peumileh proyek di ateuh → ID proyek droeneueh (Cloud overview → Dashboard → Project info → Project ID).
gcs-bucket-menu-path: Google Cloud Console → Cloud Storage → Buckets → nan bucket droeneueh (atawa Create keu peugot saboh).
gcs-key-filename-menu-path: Jalur bak server WeKan u file gunci JSON akun peulayanan nyang ka geucok (geupeugöt di yup). Ngui nyoe ATAWA tempel JSON u ruang di yup.
gcs-credentials-menu-path: Google Cloud Console → IAM & Admin → Service accounts → akun peulayanan droeneueh → Keys → Add key → Create new key → JSON → Create (geuunggah file). Tempel isi jih keunoe, atawa simpan file dan atur jalur jih di ateuh.
cloud-settings-desc: Ngon WeKan lam Weddy, Cloud Panel jipeulayan le that domain WeKan nibak saboh server, tiep-tiep ngon data droe. Bak Domain Cloud Panel, SuperAdmin geu-urôh domain ngon CloudFlare.
cloud-panel-not-allowed: Cloud Panel cit keu SuperAdmin, bak Domain Cloud Panel.
cloudflare-api-key-desc: Ngon kunci API CloudFlare, domain nyang zona jih na lam akun CloudFlare droeneuh meuteumèe rekod DNS proxy ngon sertifikat Origin CloudFlare. Domain laen meuteumèe sertifikat Let's Encrypt. Kunci geukeubah bak server ngon hana geupeuleumah le.
cloudflare-api-key-not-set: Hana kunci API CloudFlare nyang geukeubah: bandum domain meuteumèe sertifikat Let's Encrypt.
attachment-move-storage-azure: Pindah lampiran u Azure Blob Storage
attachment-move-storage-gcs: Pindah lampiran u Google Cloud Storage
gridfs-enabled-description: Ngui MongoDB GridFS keu storan file
migration-stop-confirm: Peu droeneueh yakin keuneuk peupiyôh mandum migrasi?
gridfs-move-collectionfs-note: Mangat lampiran ngön avatar jeuet geukalön, pinah awaknyan nibak CollectionFS u Storan laén.
s3-access-key-description: Access key AWS S3 keu autentikasi
s3-bucket-description: Nan S3 bucket keu keubah file
s3-enabled-description: Ngui AWS S3 atawa MinIO keu storan file
s3-endpoint-description: URL endpoint S3 (umpama, s3.amazonaws.com atawa minio.example.com)
s3-secret-key-description: Secret key AWS S3 keu autentikasi
s3-settings-saved: Peuatôran S3 ka geukeubah ngön meuhasé
writable-path-description: Jalur direktori dasar keu storan file
comprehensive-board-migration-descriptio: Geupeubuet paréksa ngön peugöt nyang leungkap keu integritas data papan, lagèe urutan dapeuta, posisi kad, ngön struktur swimlane.
delete-duplicate-empty-lists-migration-d: Hapus ngön aman dapeuta soh nyang ganda. Mantong geuhapus dapeuta nyang hana kad NGÖN na dapeuta laén ngön judul saban nyang na kad.
restore-lost-cards-migration-description: Mita ngön peuwoe kad ngön dapeuta nyang gadoh swimlaneId atawa listId. Peugöt swimlane 'Kad Gadoh' mangat mandum item nyang gadoh jeuet geukalön lom.
restore-all-archived-migration-descripti: Peuwoe mandum swimlane, dapeuta, ngön kad nyang ka geuarsip. SwimlaneId atawa listId nyang gadoh geupeugöt keudroe mangat item jeuet geukalön.
fix-missing-lists-migration-description: Mita ngön peugöt dapeuta nyang gadoh atawa reuloh lam struktur papan.
fix-avatar-urls-migration-description: Ubah URL avatar keu anggota papan mangat jingui backend storan nyang beutôi, ngön peugöt referensi avatar nyang reuloh.
fix-all-file-urls-migration-description: Ubah mandum URL lampiran file bak papan nyoe mangat jingui backend storan nyang beutôi, ngön peugöt referensi file nyang reuloh.
migrations-admin-only: Mantong peungatô papan nyang jeuet peujak migrasi
migrations-description: Peujak paréksa integritas data ngön peugöt keu papan nyoe. Tiep migrasi jeuet geupeujak sidroe-droe.
run-comprehensive-migration-confirm: Nyoe teuma peubuet migrasi nyang leungkap keu paréksa ngön peugöt integritas data papan. Nyoe jeuet meuhabéh watèe bacut. Neusambong?
run-delete-duplicate-empty-lists-migrati: Nyoe phôn teuma ubah dapeuta nyang geubagi jeuet dapeuta per-swimlane, laju hapus dapeuta soh nyang na dapeuta ganda ngön judul saban nyang na kad. Mantong dapeuta soh nyang beutôi-beutôi leubèh nyang geuhapus. Neusambong?
run-restore-lost-cards-migration-confirm: Nyoe teuma peugöt swimlane 'Kad Gadoh' ngön peuwoe mandum kad ngön dapeuta nyang gadoh swimlaneId atawa listId. Nyoe mantong keu item nyang hana geuarsip. Neusambong?
run-restore-all-archived-migration-confi: Nyoe teuma peuwoe MANDUM swimlane, dapeuta, ngön kad nyang ka geuarsip, mangat jeuet geukalön lom. Item nyang gadoh ID geupeugöt keudroe. Nyoe hana gampông geupeuwoe lom. Neusambong?
run-fix-missing-lists-migration-confirm: Nyoe teuma mita ngön peugöt dapeuta nyang gadoh atawa reuloh lam struktur papan. Neusambong?
run-fix-avatar-urls-migration-confirm: Nyoe teuma ubah URL avatar keu anggota papan mangat jingui backend storan nyang beutôi. Neusambong?
run-fix-all-file-urls-migration-confirm: Nyoe teuma ubah mandum URL lampiran file bak papan nyoe mangat jingui backend storan nyang beutôi. Neusambong?
restore-lost-cards-nothing-to-restore: Hana swimlane, dapeuta, atawa kad gadoh keu geupeuwoe
migration-progress-note: Neupreh watee kamoe migrasi papan droeneueh u struktur teubaro...
conversion-info-text: Konversi nyoe geupeubuet sigoe tiep papan ngön peugöt performa leubèh got. Droeneueh jeuet neungui papan lagèe biasa.
converting-board-description: Ubah struktur papan keu fungsi nyang leubeh got. Nyoe jeuet meujan-jan.
migration-batch-size-description: Jumlah lampiran keu geuproses tiep batch (1-100)
migration-cpu-threshold-description: Reuhat migrasi watèe peungui CPU leubèh nibak persentase nyoe (10-90)
migration-info-text: Migrasi database geupeubuet sigoe ngön peugöt performa sistem leubèh got. Proses nyan mantong jijak bak latar meuskipun droeneueh tôp browser.
migration-warning-text: Neubek tutup browser watee migrasi. Proses lanjot bak latar tapi jeuet meujan-jan keu seuleusoe.
account-locked: Akun geugunci keu siat kareuna le that ci tamong nyang gagai. Neuci lom teuma.
invalid-credentials: Nan ureueng ngui atawa sandi salah
username-password-required: Nan ureueng ngui ngön sandi wajéb na
username-too-short: Nan ureueng ngui beu paléng kureueng 3 karakter
account-created: Akun ka geupeugöt! Jinoe droeneueh jeuet tamong.
problems-summary-help: Piléh wilayah masalah nyang ka gata pariksa, óh lheuh nyan klik Akui keu reset jumlah masalah barô jih.
problems-in-progress-help: Peupinah atawa peu-ubat nyoe teungoh jijak. Tamong jeuet lambat, atawa jipeuleumah "Must be logged in" atawa "Loading, please wait", sampoe seuleusoe ngön CPU treun.
problems-none-in-progress: Hana peupinah atawa peu-ubat nyang teungoh jalan.
repair-broken-cards-done-unfixable: __fixed__ kad ka geupeu-ubat. __unfixable__ kad hana papan ngön hana jeuet geupeu-ubat keudroe.
restore-list-swimlanes-done: __restored__ dapeuta ka geupeuwoe. __remaining__ hana jeuet geupeuwoe.
export-card-details: Rincian kad (tiep kad lagee lam ekspor kad)
import-board-source: Peutamong papan (Trello, Jira, ekspor WeKan, CSV, Excel, …)
import-report-description: Papan ka geupeugot, teuma na padum bagi lam fail nyang hana jeut geuba. Laporan nyang sama geukeubah bak Panel Admin → Masalah → Peuulang.
import-parts-instruction: Bagian nyang geucek mantong geupeutamong. Pilehan nyang saban geungui watee ekspor.
import-file-label: Pileh file ekspor, atawa tempel teks jih di bawah:
sum-of-number-fields: Jumlah field khusus angka nyang geutanda keu geupeuleumah di ateuh dapeuta
date-range-of-fields: Rentang tanggai field khusus tanggai nyang geutanda keu geupeuleumah di ateuh dapeuta
twoFactorAuth-enabled: Otentikasi dua faktor ka hudép keu akun droe neuh.
twoFactorAuth-explanation: Tamah lapéh keamanan bak akun droeneueh. Watèe ka hudép, droeneueh wajéb neutuléh kode nibak aplikasi otentikator tiep kali neutamong.
twoFactorAuth-scan-instructions: Scan kode QR nyoe ngön aplikasi otentikator (umpama Google Authenticator, Authy), laju neutuléh kode 6 angka nyang jipeuleumah keu peukong.
twoFactorAuth-manual-entry: Atawa tuléh kode nyoe ngon manual:
two-factor-required-text: Situs nyoe meuphôm otentikasi dua faktor keu akun droeneuh. Atô dilèe mangat jeut neulanjut.
twoFactorCode-prompt: Tuléh kode otentikasi 6 angka droe neuh
twoFactorCode-invalid: Kode otentikasi hana sah. Neu-cuba lom.
subtask-done-no-permission: Droeneueh h'an jeuet ubah peu subtugas nyoe ka leusoe atawa goh
chart-forecast-none-remaining: Hana lé nyang mantong teuhah - bandum kad ka seuleusoe.
chart-forecast-no-velocity: __remaining__ kad mantong teuhah; hana nyang ka seuleusoe barô-barô nyoe keu meurakoe tanggai.
chart-forecast-projected: Ngön laju barô-barô nyoe __average__ kad/minggu, __remaining__ kad nyang mantong teuhah patôt seuleusoe sampoe __date__.
list-sync-description: Peubarô dapeuta nyoe nibak tracker luwa. Buet di likôt layar geupriksa tiep 15 menit; ngui "Peusaban jinoe" keu priksa langsong.
drag-to-reorder: Tarék keu meuubah urutan. Tombôi panah u ateueh ngon u miyup geupeupinah saboh teumpat.
map-view-empty: Papan nyoe gohlom na gamba peta. Ureueng nyang peuatur papan jeuet peuék saboh gamba — denah lantai, peta teumpat atawa gamba tuléh — teuma kad jeuet geupeuduek di ateueh gamba nyan.
map-view-place-hint: Tarek saboh kad u ateueh peta, atawa piléh kad nyan teuma klik bak teumpat nyang patot.
map-view-all-placed: Bandum kad na di ateueh peta.
flow-error: Hana jeuet peuluwa laporan. Priksa nilai teuma neucuba lom.
flow-note-agingWip: Kad teuhah: jumeulah uroe sit tamong u tahap jinoe. Bar mirah leubèh nibak persentil 85 sejarah tahap nyan (paleng hana limong go duek). Sejarah tamong nyang hana na hana geuteupeu.
flow-note-blockerAnalysis: Sejarah gantungan geubri watèe phôn/akhé peuhambat bak tiep tahap. Hubungan awai jeuet hana geuteupeu watèe phôn. Kad nyang ka geuhapus peureulee simpanan sejarah. Sabab nyang meutimpa geuhitong meupisah.
flow-note-monteCarlo: 2.000 cuba geucok nibak uroe kalender UTC peunoh, ngön uroe nyang hana hasé. Tanggai nakeuh ramalan ujông ateuh; jumeulah nakeuh janji ujông yup. Geuanggap hasé teuma saban ngön nyang ka; kon jaminan. Bataih paleng jioh: 3.650 uroe. Meunyoe hana nyang seuleusoe, hana ramalan.
flow-note-processBehavior: Watèe siklus ngui Phôn, meunyoe hana ngui watèe peugöt, ngön Akhé, meunyoe hana ngui watèe arsip. XmR peuleumah nilai sidroe-sidroe ngön beda meuurôt, ngön rata-rata ngön bataih proses alami; peureulee paleng hana dua seuleusoe nyang sah.
flow-note-sizeCycleTime: Peukira Planning Poker jinoe atawa saboh ruweueng khusuih angka geubandeng ngön watèe siklus nyang ka seuleusoe lam uroe. Peukira nyang hana na ngön tanggai nyang hana sah hana geuruek. Phôn meunyoe hana ngui watèe peugöt; Akhé meunyoe hana ngui watèe arsip.
time-adjustment-note: Ubah jeuem nyang ka geucatat, geukumpoi meunurôt ureueng nyang ubah jumeulah. Nyoe kon sesi buet sidroe-sidroe. Nilai negatif nakeuh peubeutôi. Watèe awai nyang hana geucatat hana jeuet geupeuhubong ngön soe pih.
blockly-ANNOUNCE_CANT_SCROLL_FURTHER: Hana jeuet peugésér nyang deuh leubèh jioh lé.
blockly-ANNOUNCE_SCROLLED_DOWN: Nyang deuh ka teugésér u yup.
blockly-ANNOUNCE_SCROLLED_LEFT: Nyang deuh ka teugésér u wie.
blockly-ANNOUNCE_SCROLLED_RIGHT: Nyang deuh ka teugésér u uneun.
blockly-ANNOUNCE_SCROLLED_UP: Nyang deuh ka teugésér u ateuëh.
blockly-ARIA_TYPE_FIELD_GRID: dapeuta nyang teubuka u yup lam kotak-kotak
blockly-CANNOT_DELETE_VARIABLE_PROCEDURE: H'an jeuet hapus variabel '%1' kareuna jih bagian nibak definisi fungsi '%2'
blockly-COLOUR_BLEND_TOOLTIP: Campô dua warna ngon nisbah nyang geubri (0.0 - 1.0).
blockly-COLOUR_RGB_TOOLTIP: Peugöt warna ngon jumlah mirah, ijô ngon biru nyang geupeuteuntée. Bandum nilai beu antara 0 ngon 100.
blockly-CONTROLS_FLOW_STATEMENTS_TOOLTIP: Teubiet nibak ulangan nyang meuisi blok nyoe.
Lompat sisa ulangan nyoe, ngon lanjut ngon ulangan lheuh nyoe.
blockly-CONTROLS_FLOW_STATEMENTS_WARNING: Peuingat: Blok nyoe jeuet geungui lam ulangan mantong.
blockly-CONTROLS_FOREACH_TOOLTIP: Keu tiep item lam dapeuta, atô variabel '%1' u item nyan, lheuh nyan peubuet padum boh peunyata.
blockly-CONTROLS_FOR_TOOLTIP: Peujeuet variabel '%1' meucok nilai nibak angka phon sampoe angka akhé, geuitông ngon jarak nyang geupeuteuntée, ngon peubuet blok nyang geupeuteuntée.
blockly-CONTROLS_IF_ELSE_TOOLTIP: Tamah syarat akhé nyang meuliputi bandum u blok meunyoe.
blockly-CONTROLS_IF_IF_TOOLTIP: Tamah, hapus, atawa peuatô urotan bagian keu atô ulang blok meunyoe nyoe.
blockly-CONTROLS_IF_TOOLTIP_1: Meunyoe saboh nilai beutôi, peubuet padum boh peunyata.
blockly-CONTROLS_IF_TOOLTIP_2: Meunyoe saboh nilai beutôi, peubuet blok peunyata phon. Meunyoe kon, peubuet blok peunyata keudua.
blockly-CONTROLS_IF_TOOLTIP_3: Meunyoe nilai phon beutôi, peubuet blok peunyata phon. Meunyoe kon, meunyoe nilai keudua beutôi, peubuet blok peunyata keudua.
blockly-CONTROLS_IF_TOOLTIP_4: Meunyoe nilai phon beutôi, peubuet blok peunyata phon. Meunyoe kon, meunyoe nilai keudua beutôi, peubuet blok peunyata keudua. Meunyoe hana saboh nilai pih nyang beutôi, peubuet blok peunyata akhé.
blockly-CONTROLS_REPEAT_TOOLTIP: Peubuet padum boh peunyata padum goe.
blockly-CONTROLS_WHILEUNTIL_TOOLTIP_UNTI: Seulama saboh nilai salah, peubuet padum boh peunyata.
blockly-CONTROLS_WHILEUNTIL_TOOLTIP_WHIL: Seulama saboh nilai beutôi, peubuet padum boh peunyata.
blockly-HELP_PROMPT: Teukan %1 keu bantuan kontrol papan kunci.
blockly-KEYBOARD_NAV_CONSTRAINED_MOVE_HI: Ngui kunci panah keu pinah, lheuh nyan %1 keu teurimong posisi.
blockly-KEYBOARD_NAV_FLYOUT_LABEL_HINT: Ngui kunci panah keu jak u saboh blok, atawa teukan %1 keu jak u judul lheuh nyoe.
blockly-KEYBOARD_NAV_UNCONSTRAINED_MOVE_: Teukan %1 ngon ngui kunci panah keu pinah bebaih, lheuh nyan %2 keu teurimong posisi.
blockly-LISTS_CREATE_EMPTY_TOOLTIP: Geupeuwoe saboh dapeuta, panyang 0, nyang hana meuisi catatan data
blockly-LISTS_CREATE_WITH_CONTAINER_TOOL: Tamah, hapus, atawa peuatô urotan bagian keu atô ulang blok dapeuta nyoe.
blockly-LISTS_CREATE_WITH_TOOLTIP: Peugöt dapeuta ngon padum pih item.
blockly-LISTS_GET_INDEX_TOOLTIP_GET_FROM: Geupeuwoe item bak posisi nyang geupeuteuntée lam dapeuta.
blockly-LISTS_GET_INDEX_TOOLTIP_GET_REMO: Geuhapus ngon geupeuwoe item phon lam dapeuta.
Geuhapus ngon geupeuwoe item bak posisi nyang geupeuteuntée lam dapeuta.
Geuhapus ngon geupeuwoe item akhé lam dapeuta.

blockly-LISTS_GET_INDEX_TOOLTIP_REMOVE_F: Geuhapus item bak posisi nyang geupeuteuntée lam dapeuta.
blockly-LISTS_GET_SUBLIST_TOOLTIP: Geupeugöt salinan bagian nyang geupeuteuntée nibak dapeuta.

scrum-rollover-sprint: Pinah buet nyang goh leusoe u
scrum-edit-sprint: Peugöt atawa sunting sprint nyang geurencana
scrum-releases-select-help: Saboh kad jeuet na lam padum boh rilis. Teukan Ctrl (Cmd bak Mac) keu pileh leubeh nibak saboh; peugléh bandum keu hapus kad nibak bandum rilis.
scrum-select-sprint: Pileh saboh sprint keu kalon laporan jih.
scrum-backlog-help: Peuurot buet ngon peringkat backlog. Bri kad u sprint nyang geurencana atawa aktif.
scrum-no-closed-sprints: Hana cuplikan sprint nyang ka geutôp.
scrum-report-help: Laporan geupeutheun peukira nibak cuplikan sprint. Peukira nyang h'an geuthee geuitông keudroe; kon peukira sifar. Bandeng kecepatan antara satuan peukira ngon aturan nyang saban mantong.
scrum-confirm-close: Tôp sprint nyoe ngon keubah hase jih? Kad nyang goh leusoe geupinah u teumpat nyang geupileh.
scrum-confirm-cancel: Batai sprint nyoe? Kad jih tetap anggota sampoe geubri u teumpat laen.
scrum-partial-report: Laporan sibagian: kad nyang jinoe geubri u droeneueh mantong nyang rôh.
scrum-import-reference-omitted: Saboh rujukan sumber h'an jeuet geupeuwoe: __reference__
scrum-partial-snapshot: Sprint nyoe meuisi sibagian nibak cuplikan asli mantong.
scrum-rollover-progress: Teungoh pinah kad sprint u keue: __done__ nibak __total__
scrum-history-job-running: Teungoh peubalék peugantoe raya atawa peugöt lom: __done__ nibak __total__ bareh sejarah
scrum-history-job-failed: Peubalék atawa peugöt lom peugantoe raya ka piyôh. Teugon peubalék atawa peugöt lom sigoe treuk keu peulanjut:
scrum-daily-observations: Cakupan ngon buet nyang tinggai tiep uroe (pengamatan)
scrum-daily-observations-help: Tiep batang geupeuleumah pengamatan phon nyang geucatat bak saboh uroe UTC, bak cap watèe nyang geupeuleumah. Uroe nyang hana h'an geupeuleumah. Pengamatan nyoe h'an geucatat bandum peuubahan atawa h'an geupeuleumah jumlah akhé uroe. Peukira nyang h'an geuthee kon sifar. Ngui buet Ekspor bagian nyoe keu pengamatan tiep uroe; buet Ekspor bak baréh alat geuekspor hase sprint.
scrum-daily-truncated: 366 pengamatan nyang paleng barô mantong nyang geupeuleumah.
scrum-daily-empty: Goh na pengamatan tiep uroe nyang geucatat keu sprint nyoe.
scrum-scope-history: Lingkôp buet ngon buet nyang tinggai, sigoe-sigoe gantoe
scrum-scope-history-help: Teupeugèt lom nibak Sejarah papan phon sprint jipeuphon: saboh baréh keu tieb gantoe bak kad, kira-kira atawa buet nyang ka seuleusoe lam sprint.
scrum-scope-history-inconsistent: Sejarah hana jeuet peugèt lom keuadaan sprint nyang ka teusimpan: na padum gantoe nyang hana teucatat lam Sejarah, jadi nilai nyoe gohlom leungkap.
scrum-scope-history-truncated: Gantoe nyang phon-phon mantöng nyang jeuet teubeuet; peugèt lom nyoe gohlom leungkap.
scrum-scope-cause-scrum: Kad nyang lam sprint ka meugantoe
scrum-scope-cause-lifecycle: Kad ka teupeutamong lam arsip atawa teupeuwoe lom
scrum-daily-observations-export-help: Pengamatan phon nyang geucatat bak tiep uroe UTC; uroe nyang hana h'an geupeuleumah. Pengamatan h'an geucatat bandum peuubahan atawa jumlah akhé uroe. Peukira nyang h'an geuthee kon sifar.
scrum-import-pending: Impor Scrum goh leusoe. Sunting Scrum ngon ekspor laporan hana.
scrum-import-recovery-hint: Impor nyang teupeupiyôh sabab peuphon lom jeuet teupeuseuleusoe di sinoe meunyoe ka piyôh. Meunyoe rencana jih gohlom teusimpan leungkap, impor nyan jeuet teubôih mantöng; nyan hana geugantoe sapeue bak papan.
scrum-import-into-board: Impor rencana Scrum u papan nyoe
scrum-import-into-board-hint: Pileh ekspor papan WeKan atawa file transfer Scrum. Sprint ngon rilis nyang ka na bak papan nyoe geuhubong, h'an tom geuduplikat. Kad geupeusaban ngon ID, atawa ngon nomor ngon judul kad; kad nyang h'an saban geutuléh ngon h'an geuubah. Kalon phon keu theui peue nyang meuubah.
scrum-import-invalid-file: File nyoe kon JSON nyang sah.
scrum-import-preview-sprints: Sprint: __created__ barô, __matched__ ka na bak papan nyoe, __skipped__ h'an geuimpor
scrum-import-preview-releases: Rilis: __created__ barô, __matched__ ka na bak papan nyoe, __skipped__ h'an geuimpor
scrum-import-preview-cards: Kad: __updated__ keu geuperbarô, __unchanged__ h'an meuubah, __unmatched__ h'an saban
scrum-import-preview-nothing: Hana nyang meuubah: papan nyoe ka na rencana nyoe.
scrum-import-into-board-done: Rencana Scrum ka geuimpor ngon geucatat lam Riwayat.
scrum-import-card-not-matched: Saboh kad h'an meuteumee bak papan nyoe: __reference__
scrum-import-card-ambiguous: Saboh kad saban ngon leubeh nibak saboh kad bak papan nyoe: __reference__
scrum-import-card-on-another-board: Saboh kad milék papan laen ngon h'an geuubah: __reference__

scrum-import-record-not-imported: Saboh sprint, rilis atawa acara h'an jeuet geuimpor: __reference__
scrum-import-sprint-finished: Saboh kad h'an geupinah u sprint nyang ka leusoe: __reference__
sync-conflict-hint: Pileh saboh nilai keu tiep konflik. Sinkron geuculok lom lheuh tiep peumileh. Hana nyang geukirém u sistem sumber.
sync-conflict-refresh: Jalan Sinkron lom keu kalon nilai jinoe.
sync-conflict-review-complete: Kad nyang geubri u droeneueh ka geukalon. Hana konflik ruang nyang tinggai. Sinkron dapeuta peunoh h'an geujalan.
sync-conflict-detach-hint: Hapus peumetaan Sinkron duplikat nyoe mantong. Isi jih tetap lam WeKan.
sync-conflict-archive: Arsip geuhambat le subkad nyang aktif
sync-conflict-archive-hint: Item sumber ka gadoh, tapi subkad nyang aktif geuhambat arsip. Peutheun kad nyoe secara lokal ngon geuhapus peumetaan Sinkron jih. Subkad h'an geuubah.
sync-conflict-creation-hint: Peutheun kad sigohlom nyoe h'an geuubah ngon peugöt kad Sinkron barô lam dapeuta nyoe. Culok lom geungui peuganto nyan.
sync-preview-saved: Meudasar peuatôran nyang ka geukeubah. Sinkron jinoe geucok ngon geucek sumber lom.
sync-preview-unavailable: Keubah sumber Sinkron sigohlom lakée kalon.
sync-preview-blocked: Peuleusoe konflik di bawah sigohlom kalon rencana peuubahan.
sync-preview-scope: Jumlah meuhubong ngon ruang sumber nyang ka geunormalkan. Data tamahan jeuet h'an geurôh le pengurai sumber.
sync-preview-excluded: H'an geurôh le peumileh ruang nyang ka geukeubah
sync-preview-parser-unsupported: Bagian nyang h'an geurôh geulapor le pengurai
sync-source-heading: Ruang sumber nyang h'an geusalin langsong
sync-source-scope: Jalur geukelompok kejadian ruang antara item sumber. Objek nyang hana peumetaan geulapor sibagoe sabohsapat; nilai jih h'an geupeuleumah.
sync-source-excluded: H'an geurôh le peumileh ruang nyang ka geukeubah
sync-source-converted: Geuubah u teks atawa bentuk laen
sync-source-fallback: Nilai ganto nyang h'an geungui le pengurai
sync-source-excluded-item: Item nyang h'an geurôh le pengurai
sync-source-occurrences: Kejadian ruang atawa item nyang geulapor
sync-source-truncated: Laporan geubataih 100 jalur ngon nan ruang nyang geupeuseupot.
sync-source-omitted: Kejadian tamahan di luwa jalur nyang geupeuleumah
sync-report-retention: 20 jalan paleng barô. Laporan geupeutheun 30 uroe.
sync-report-partial: Jalan nyang gagai atawa goh leusoe mungkin ka geuubah padum boh kad. Laporan nyoe h'an geulanjut atawa geubatai saboh jalan.
sync-report-unfinished: Teungoh jalan atawa meuputôh; hase h'an geucatat
sync-report-completed-with-warnings: Leusoe ngon ruang nyang h'an geurôh atawa geuubah
sync-report-unavailable: Laporan jalan peureulee akses tuléh dapeuta peunoh ngon server nyang na.
sync-recovery-description: Laporan Sinkron nyang geupeutheun nibak 30 uroe akhé. Mita ngon ID papan atawa dapeuta. Hase nyang goh leusoe mungkin mantong jalan atawa meuputôh. Peubarô keu cek lom; laporan nyoe h'an jeuet geulanjut atawa geubatai peuubahan.
sync-recovery-unavailable: H'an jeuet baca diagnostik Sinkron. Cek akses admin ngon ketersediaan server.
sync-estimate-field-hint: Pileh ruang angka ngon ID ruang Jira ngon satuan peukira, lagee nyang geupeugöt le impor Jira nyang geumetakan. Peuubahan lokal geukalon sibagoe konflik. Nilai sumber nyang hana h'an geupeuduli; null nyang jeulaih geupeugléh nilai nyang geumetakan.
sync-estimate-field-gitlab-hint: Beurat atawa kira-kira watèe GitLab teutuléh lam teumpat angka nyang droeneuh piléh. Gantoe di sinoe teuperéksa sibagoe nyang hana saban; masalah nyang hana beurat geupeugléh nilai nyang ka teupeusambông.
email-recovery-description: Saboh bareh keu ureueng nyang teurimong maséng-maséng. Mita ngon ID ureueng ngui. Aso peusan ngon kolom emel ureueng nyang teurimong hana geupeuleumah. Peupioh siat geutahan peusan nyang ka na ngon nyang teuma teuka; peulanjut geucuba kirem lom peusan lam daftar jinoe. Batal geuboih peusan nyang ka tamong daftar trok bak watee peumintaan. Meunyo mantong geukirem, cuba lom lheueh siat. Peusan nyang ka geupeuphon kirem hana jeuet tacok woe, ngon peungiriman nyang hana pasti hasé jih jeuet teukirem dua go. Peungiriman nyang gagal sabe ngon peusan nyang ka trok bateueh cuba geukeubah keu geupeurèksa. Cuba lom peusan nyang gagal geupeuphon putaran cuba barô ngon geujaga peupioh siat nyang ka na.
email-recovery-empty: Hana peusan lam daftar atawa ureueng nyang peungiriman keu jih ka geupeupioh siat.
email-recovery-unavailable: Hana jeuet geubeuet daftar emel. Peurèksa hak ureueng atô ngon meunyo server jeuet geungui.
email-recovery-busy: Teungoh geukirem atawa geupeubuet buet laén bak daftar. Peubarô ngon cuba lom lheueh siat.
email-recovery-failed: Buet nyoe hana jeuet geupasti. Peubarô daftar ngon cuba lom buet nyang saban meunyo peureulèe.
email-recovery-superseded: Buet nyang leubèh barô nibak ureueng peujak sistem ka geuganto peumintaan nyoe. Keuadaan daftar jinoe geupeuleumah.
email-recovery-confirm-cancel: Batal mandum peusan nyang jinoe lam daftar keu ureueng nyang teurimong nyoe? Aso jih geuboih ngon hana jeuet geupeuwoe lom. Peusan barô nyang geupeugöt lheueh peumintaan nyoe geukeubah.
email-failure-recipient-unavailable: Ureueng teurimong hana atawa akun geupeumate
email-failure-delivery-unconfirmed: Kirém h'an jeuet geupeuseuhah; kalon sigohlom culok lom
email-failure-acknowledgement-failed: Tanda teurimong kirém h'an jeuet geukeubah
sync-time-estimate-hint: Peukira watèe jingui ruang angka watèe asli/tinggai nyang geupeugöt le impor Jira. Pah saboh ruang nyang saban beuna bak papan nyoe. Sunting lokal geukalon sibagoe konflik; nilai sumber nyang hana h'an geupeuduli ngon null nyang jeulaih geupeugléh nilai.
sync-planning-hint: Sprint ngon rilis geusinkron seulama Scrum hudep bak papan nyoe mantong. Sprint atawa rilis nyang hana geupeugöt bak papan nyoe, ngon tanggal nibak sumber; nyang ka na geupeusaban ngon ID sumber jih phon, lheuh nyan ngon nan. Peuubahan rencana lokal tetap sampoe sumber geuubah rencana isu nyan, ngon Sinkron phon h'an tom geuhapus rencana.
activity-recovery-description: Haba nyang goh leusoe geuculok lom secara otomatis. Kalon aktivitas nyang gadoh atawa meuubah sigohlom culok lom. Culok lom h'an tom geupeugöt ulang aktivitas.
activity-recovery-empty: Hana haba aktivitas nyang goh geukirém.
activity-recovery-unavailable: H'an jeuet muat haba aktivitas nyang goh geukirém.
activity-recovery-status-inconsistent: Rencana ngon aktivitas nyang goh geukirém h'an saban
activity-recovery-busy: Pekerja laen teungoh urôh haba nyoe. Peubarô ngon culok lom.
activity-recovery-denied: Akses ureueng teurimong atawa peumileh haba h'an le geubri izin kirém.
activity-recovery-source-unavailable: Aktivitas asli gadoh atawa ka meuubah. Hana nyang geupeugöt ulang.
activity-recovery-failed: H'an jeuet peuleusoe kirém haba. Buet nyang goh leusoe geupeutheun.
activity-recovery-control-conflict: Haba nyoe ka meuubah lheuh geumuat. Kalon keuadaan nyang ka geupeubarô sigohlom culok lom.
activity-recovery-control-failed: H'an jeuet peuseuhah peuatôran kirém. Peubarô ngon kalon keuadaan jih jinoe.
activity-recovery-cancel-confirm: Batai keu sabe kirém nyang tinggai keu aktivitas nyoe? Nyoe h'an jeuet geulanjut. Emel nyang ka lam antrian ngon haba nyang ka geukirém h'an geucok woe.
rule-email-recovery-description: Perèksa usaha kirem surat èlektronik atôran nyang ka teucatat. Usaha nyang gohlom pasti mungkén mantong teungoh kirem atawa ka teuganggu. Buka saboh ngon "Paréksa" keu kirem lom, bôh tanda ka geukirem atawa peubateuë peungiriman.
rule-email-recovery-sent: Ka jiteurimong lé server surat èlektronik
rule-email-recovery-invalid: Data nyang peugah bhah usaha hana sah
rule-email-recovery-empty: Hana usaha kirem surat èlektronik atôran nyang sisuai ngon mita nyoe.
rule-email-recovery-unavailable: H'an jeuet muat culok emel aturan. Peubarô keu culok lom.
rule-email-recovery-actions-hint: WeKan hana tom jikirem lom keudroe surat èlektronik nyang gohlom pasti. Kirem lom nyan mantong keu ureuëng nyang gohlom pasti teurimong. Bôh tanda ka geukirem meunyo droeneuh neuteupeue ka trôh, atawa peubateuë.
rule-email-recovery-wait: Peungiriman nyang phon mungkén mantong meujalan. Droeneuh jeuet neupileh o lheueh __time__.
rule-email-recovery-resend: Kirem lom keu ureuëng nyang gohlom pasti teurimong
rule-email-recovery-resend-confirm: Kirem lom surat èlektronik nyoe keu ureuëng nyang gohlom pasti teurimong? So mantong nyang server surat jih ka teurimong tan peugah ubak WeKan, jih teurimong dua goe.
rule-email-recovery-mark-sent-confirm: Bôh tanda surat èlektronik nyoe ka geukirem keu mandum? Peugot nyoe meunyo droeneuh neuteupeue ka trôh mantong.
rule-email-recovery-drop-confirm: Peubateuë surat èlektronik nyoe? Hana geukirem keu ureuëng nyang gohlom pasti teurimong.
rule-email-resolution-too-early: Peungiriman nyang phon mungkén mantong meujalan. Cuba lom euntreuk.
rule-email-resolution-resend-in-flight: Peungiriman ulang nyang ka leupah mungkén mantong meujalan. Cuba lom euntreuk.
rule-email-resolution-nothing-to-resend: Mandum ureuëng nyang teurimong ka pasti. Bôh tanda ka geukirem, beu nyan nyang geupeugot.
rule-email-resolution-resend-uncertain: Server surat hana jijaweueb. Surat nyang geukirem lom mungkén ka trôh atawa hana trôh; geupeuleumah lagee mantong meujalan.
rule-email-resolution-busy: Pangurôh laén teungoh geupeuseuleusoe surat èlektronik nyoe. Cuba lom siat teuk.
rule-email-resolution-command-changed: Surat èlektronik nyang geukeubah hana sisuai lé ngon peucubaan nyoe, jadi hana jeuet geupeuseuleusoe di sinoe.
rule-email-resolution-attempt-invalid: Catatan nyang geukeubah keu peucubaan nyoe hana beutôi, jadi hana jeuet geupeuseuleusoe di sinoe.
rule-email-resolution-failed: Hana jeuet geupeuseuleusoe surat èlektronik nyoe. Muat lom ngon cuba lom.
rule-email-legacy-heading: Surat èlektronik aturan nyang teungoh geupreh paréksa
rule-email-legacy-description: Surat èlektronik aturan nyoe geupeusiap lé versi WeKan nyang awai nyang hana geucatét nibak pat asai asoe jih, jadi WeKan hana jikirem keudroe. Paréksa dilèë peu nyang peugot aturan mantong na hak tamong, lheueh nyan peusambông lom surat mangat geupeusiap lom nibak keureutu lagee jinoe, atawa bôh surat nyan.
rule-email-legacy-reason-details-snapsho: Keuteurangan keureutu nibak versi nyang awai
rule-email-legacy-rebind-confirm: Peusiap lom surat èlektronik nyoe nibak keureutu lagee jinoe? Asoe jih mungkén meulaén ngon nyang ka geupeusiap dilèë.
rule-email-legacy-discard-confirm: Bôh surat èlektronik nyoe? Hana geukirem sabé-sabé.
rule-email-legacy-empty: Hana surat èlektronik aturan nyang teungoh geupreh paréksa.
rule-email-legacy-unavailable: Hana jeuet geumuat surat èlektronik aturan nyang teungoh geupreh paréksa. Muat lom mangat jeuet cuba lom.
rule-email-legacy-access-denied: Nyang peugot aturan hana hak tamong lé u keureutu nyoe, atawa aturan ka meuubah, jadi surat hana jeuet geupeusambông lom. Droeneuh jeuet neubôh.
rule-email-legacy-source-changed: Keugiatan nyang peuphôn surat èlektronik nyoe ka meuubah, jadi hana jeuet geupeusambông lom. Droeneuh jeuet neubôh.
rule-email-legacy-source-unavailable: Keureutu nibak asai surat èlektronik nyoe hana lé, jadi hana jeuet geupeusambông lom. Droeneuh jeuet neubôh.
rule-email-legacy-plan-unavailable: Peulaksanaan aturan nyang peusiap surat èlektronik nyoe hana geukeubah lé, jadi hana jeuet geupeusambông lom. Droeneuh jeuet neubôh.
rule-email-legacy-attempt-exists: Surat èlektronik nyoe ka geukirem, ka geucuba kirem, atawa ka geubôh.
rule-email-legacy-not-legacy: Surat èlektronik nyoe ka geupeusambông lom.
rule-email-legacy-failed: Hana jeuet geupeuseuleusoe buet nyoe. Muat lom ngon cuba lom.
stuck-sync-operation-heading: Operasi Sinkron Dapeuta nyang h'an jeuet geujalan lom
